profile.name: Sumanth Kumar Sivadi
profile.title: AI ENGINEER
profile.bio: AI Engineer with 4+ years of experience delivering end-to-end AI/ML solutions across the healthcare and financial services domains, specializing in predictive models, fraud and credit-risk solutions, clinical decision-support systems, and patient outcome analytics. Highly proficient in Python, SQL, and PySpark, with hands-on experience across AWS, Azure, Databricks, and Snowflake. Strong expertise in building and validating ML, deep learning, NLP, and transformer models, engineering GenAI/RAG and agentic AI workflows, and deploying production-grade AI systems with MLOps practices for versioning, monitoring, and automated retraining. Proven ability to thrive in Agile environments, delivering reliable, production-ready AI solutions that improve model accuracy, processing efficiency, and operational decision-making.
